paragraphs: The new Apple TV 4K lets you ask Siri AI what to watch from across the room, no remote required.
The A19-powered box arrives November 13 for $299, making it $100 more expensive than the previous model’s starting price. It’s the first Apple TV 4K refresh since 2022.
The new Apple TV supports four-speaker surround sound, and it finally gets perhaps the most-requested feature ever: The new Siri Remote gets Find My — making a lost clicker a thing of the past.

The new Apple TV 4K finally gives the living room a brain. Siri AI brings conversational search, on-screen answers, and hands-free voice control to the big screen, while the new A19 chip and built-in microphones elevate the box from a simple streaming device to an intelligent home-theater hub.
Apple unveiled the new Apple TV 4K on Tuesday, at a “Welcome Home” event in New York. The company calls Siri AI an entirely new version of Siri powered by Apple Intelligence.

On Apple TV 4K, the assistant is designed to become a primary interface. It fills the screen with answers. Simply ask which Apple TV shows won Emmys this year, and it will show poster art from the Apple TV app. You’ll also see follow-up suggestions and more award-winning comedies.

While you watch, Siri AI can answer questions about the show. Apple’s examples include where Pluribus was filmed and whether a specific show is appropriate for a 15-year-old to watch. Answers appear in a compact overlay, so you can read them while the picture stays on screen.
If you have an Apple Intelligence-enabled iPhone, Siri AI can also make use of personal context. For example, you can ask Siri AI to play a show someone recommended.
